title: The desert has its own sound
changes: The Sunscar now has desert sounds: a dry wind hissing with sand, far-off chimes, camel bells and a hawk high above

Music slots for Act 2 are ready: a main theme when you first step through the waygate, calm tunes for Kel Ashar, the dunes, the oases and the buried city, a desert battle song and a boss song for Ishael the Sunwright (the songs arrive in a coming update)
